scope: OctoSense App Hub, Glance presentation and existing OctoScript app interfaces; desktop and Android. UI acceptance, not live-service release sign-off.
reviewer: Codex author self-review, not independent human approval

anchors.0: Blocked task or essential content unreadable
anchors.0.8: Usable but visible inconsistency or coverage gap
anchors.0.9: Polished in observed states; minor limitations remain
anchors.1: All specified states, widths and repeated journeys verified

hard_gates: No clipped or obscured essential editor/action
Physical-device checks are never replaced by desktop phone previews
Unverified required cases prevent a final pass

criteria: One prominent next action in empty and populated states
Related actions remain next to their content
Readable text and focus in light and dark
Essential text and actions fit at phone and desktop widths
Unicode and multiline edits save the intended values
Native Android keyboard leaves editors and actions reachable
Dismissal and return preserve the correct item
Six workspaces retain distinct unsent input beyond clean cache capacity
Saved events, stories and bookmarks survive restart
Light/dark switches retain the active unsaved editor
Measured repeated editor-open observations with explicit method
Bounded background polling stops while editing
Touch navigation works from all tested Glance start heights
One shared app interface with generated-copy check
App Hub, summaries and full apps retain coherent hierarchy
Theme changes include map content as well as controls
